acceptance: A session-start or preflight check reports when the primary clone is behind origin/develop on paths that sessions load from it (hook files, agent settings, the _project/scripts lock), and names the commands to update.
The check also reports when the running tracker server version differs from the version pinned on develop.
The update procedure (pull, uv sync --project _project/scripts --locked, restart sessions) is written in one place in docs/agent, and the rule about who may run it is stated.
description: Agent sessions start in the primary clone. They launch the tracker MCP server from its _project/scripts environment and load agent hooks from its checked-out files. Agents may not update that clone, and it is not kept current. On 2026-11-12 it was 19 commits behind origin/develop a day after two fixes merged: the tracker runtime was still tractable 1.1.0 although develop pinned 1.1.1 (PR #4144), and the primary-clone write guard (PR #4143) did not exist there, so it protected nothing. Nothing told the owner or the sessions. A merged fix to session tooling therefore has no effect until someone happens to pull, sync and restart.
